status: Verified local scene Set optimization; broad and large-instance work remain visible.
change: Resolve and validate touched source records when address membership, hierarchy/source and live mappings are unchanged; otherwise use full resolution. Common typed preflight/publication, op rollback, authored baseline and external writes retained.
quality: 41 ara-sim/ara-play tests and all-target clippy pass; independent review including large prefab expansion fix has no must-fix findings. All 28 measured processes agree on complete canonical source, runtime state and portable snapshot hashes by case, and retain authored handles/preexisting runtime values. Runtime divergence, typed rejection, stale preimage rollback, external publication, references, lifetime generations, snapshot/replay and full fallbacks covered separately in tests.
baseline: 53dcadd57 projection.rs and identical new probe/other libraries versus candidate projection modules. Source restoration verified. Immutable executable hashes, source hashes and build commands retained below.
method: 100000 entities, one excluded warmup and three apply_ops samples per fresh process. Initial two reversed rounds, then two reversed all-record-only follow-ups prompted by the initial 21.5% full-wave increase. Setup, verification and snapshot export excluded. Follow-up is additional evidence, not a reason to discard the slower original sample. No allocation instrumentation. AC was observed; no power setting/action performed.
limits: One plain edit p50 215/226ms -> .844/.900ms; 1% and 10% edits also benefit. A 100k-row prefab contribution is still resolved entirely: name/override ~146-148ms, only small gains. Original full-wave after 931ms vs before 766ms (+21.5%) is retained; reverse 747/774ms, fresh repeats after 774/776 vs before 769/766 (+0.7%/+1.4%). Full-wave overhead/variability is not established as zero. Public API CPU apply_ops only, not complete editor latency, Play startup, compile time or Unity superiority. Three samples do not establish tail latency.

initial_rounds.scope: Ara CPU preparation/host feature experiment; no Unity, shipping frame or universal superiority claim.
initial_rounds.method: Two fresh-process rounds with reversed order, nice10. Kernel samples exclude setup/verification; separate untimed Rust allocation counts. Resource guards before/after cannot prove continuous absence of interference. Worker arguments are pool workers plus a participating caller, not total hardware cores.
